library_preparation_preflight.summary: The 6 uncovered dynamic accesses are all public methods/constructors on two small Lombok-generated config beans (PostgreSQLConfigurationExtension, TransactionalModel), already reachable via the running postgres:18-alpine container and the already-imported flyway-database-postgresql dependency in the generated scaffold. Closing the gap only requires the test to call more of those beans' existing getters/setters directly in Java — no new dependency, Docker image, or environment/system property is needed.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Expand FlywayDatabasePostgresqlTests to directly exercise the two classes named in reachability-metadata.json, beyond the single setTransactionalLock(false) call already present: call getNamespace(), getConfigurationParameterFromEnvironmentVariable("FLYWAY_POSTGRESQL_TRANSACTIONAL_LOCK"), getTransactional()/setTransactional(new TransactionalModel()), equals/hashCode/toString on PostgreSQLConfigurationExtension, and getLock()/setLock() on TransactionalModel. getConfigurationParameterFromEnvironmentVariable takes the variable name as a String parameter and does a hardcoded string comparison internally — it does not read System.getenv() — so no real environment variable needs to be exported to cover it; just pass the literal name as an argument.
